entities.summary: The Cathedral Basilica of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary and St. Nicholas also called Łowicz Cathedral is a religious building affiliated with the Catholic Church and is located in the city of Łowicz in the Łódź Voivodeship, Poland.
